mechanism: CNA CVE-2026-56678 (GitHub_M) source.advisory is GitHub-reviewed GHSA-6mwv-4mrm-5p3m, omitted from the row public_ids. Advisory names POST /api/oauth/kiro/api-key interpolating user-controlled region into https://codewhisperer.${region}.amazonaws.com and forwarding the submitted API key as Authorization. Parent 3de6ce15 has no api-key route; list-profiles host is hardcoded codewhisperer.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Member 706e6513 (Claude Opus 4.8 and Cursor trailers) adds the route, validateApiKey, and listAvailableProfiles with unvalidated region. Fix 126aa244 (GHSA-6mwv in subject) adds assertValidAwsRegion before interpolation and stops reflecting upstream bodies. Published GitHub releases v0.5.2 (tag commit 5da508af, GHSA-named) and v0.5.4 contain origin without the fix; v0.5.6 contains 126aa244.
notes: Batch IV: Row public_ids listed only CVE-2026-56678; first-party GHSA-6mwv-4mrm-5p3m is the CNA source advisory. GHSA affected <= 0.5.2 understates git: published tag v0.5.4 also contains origin without the fix. Tag v0.5.4 package.json version is 0.5.3; v0.5.6 package.json is 0.5.4. Parent already interpolated region into oidc.${region}.amazonaws.com on the OAuth device-flow path; that is not the named API-key Authorization-forwarding sink.
Promotion consolidation: POST /api/oauth/kiro/api-key region interpolation with Authorization forwarding

fp211_adjudication.lesson: A first-party repo GHSA plus a new API-key route that interpolates user region into the AWS host is enough even when the global GHSA endpoint 404s.
